head.t: GE HealthCare introduces new CT platforms and workflow enhancements
head.x: Medical Device Network reports GE HealthCare has introduced new CT platforms and workflow enhancements.

head.t: GE HealthCare launches ViewPoint Ultra ultrasound workflow software
head.x: GE HealthCare has launched ViewPoint Ultra to help health systems standardise ultrasound documentation and reporting across sites and departments.

head.t: GE HealthCare lines up PET, CT scanners and AI programs for US review
head.x: GE HealthCare has PET and CT scanners and AI software lined up for US regulatory review.

head.t: GE HealthCare adds Lung Guidance and AutoAS artificial intelligence tools to Vscan Air SL handheld ultrasound
head.x: GE HealthCare announced two features for the Vscan Air SL on 03/11/2026: Lung Guidance (probe guidance across the eight-zone lung protocol, with B-line detection and scoring) and AutoAS (a diagnostic aid flagging possible moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from at least two views).
